title: Los Angeles weather: Sunshine coming to Southern California as rain tapers off, mild temperatures expected - ABC7 Los Angeles
text:
Los Angeles weather: Sunshine coming to Southern California as rain tapers off, mild temperatures expected - ABC7 Los Angeles 
 24/7 Live Los Angeles Orange County Inland Empire Ventura County California Weather 
 SoCal rain to tapers off ahead of weeklong sunshine, mild temperatures 
 Monday, November 2, 2026 2:59AM 
 Este artículo se ofrece en Español Rainy conditions are expected to taper off across Southern California, giving way to a week of sunshine and mild temperatures. LOS ANGELES (KABC) -- Rainy conditions are expected to taper off across Southern California, giving way to a week of sunshine and mild temperatures.
 The storm is expected to clear out of the region by Monday, when temperatures will slightly rise amid sunny skies that will last throughout the week.
 Los Angeles and Orange County will see sunshine Monday with a high of 75 degrees and a low of 58. Similar conditions are expected Tuesday.
 The valleys and the Inland Empire will see a high of 75 degrees and a low of 55 Monday, amid sunny skies. Similar conditions are on tap for Tuesday. A slight warm-up is expected by the weekend.
 The beaches can expect sunny conditions Monday, with a high of 74 degrees and a low of 60. Surf is expected to be between 2 and 4 ft.
 Mountain communities will see mostly sunny skies Monday, with a high of 57 degrees and a low of 33. Similar conditions are on tap for Tuesday.
 The deserts can expect a high of 69 degrees and a low of 43 Monday. Palm Springs is expected to reach 79 degrees.
